translations.name: Wichita Transit Half-Fare Program
translations.description: People who qualify can ride Wichita buses for 85 cents. You may qualify if you are 65 or older, have Medicare, or have a qualifying disability. Apply for a free Half-Fare ID card and show it when you board. Call 316-265-7221 with questions.
translations.website_description: Learn who can get a Half-Fare ID card and how to apply.
